To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the spatially forced complex Ginzburg Landau equations exhibit a wave-unlocking transition.
the spatial frequency forcing of standing waves in a system of two complex Ginzburg Landau equations leads to a wave-unlocking transition.

(a) the forcing frequency is not affected by the forcing strength, (b) the forcing frequency can be controlled by the coupling strength, (c) the forcing amplitude controls the bifurcation threshold, and (d) the forcing amplitude can control the spatial period of the modulations.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effect of spatial forcing on standing waves of coupled complex GINZBURG-LANDAU equations.
the effect of spatially periodic forcing on the bifurcation structure of standing waves in the context of coupled complex GINZBURG-LANDAU equations.
the effect of spatially modulated forcing on standing-wave patterns of the coupled complex Ginzbg-Landau equations and with the transition to temporally modulated patterns.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the effect of spatial forcing on standing waves is to introduce a frequency locking which is broken at a threshold.
a standing wave is unstable to forcing if and only if it is unstable to a small spatial perturbation.
the system presents a transition from a frequency-locked regime into a frequency-locked state with a spatial modulation of the amplitude and phase, which bifurcates into a frequency- unlocked state.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the wave-unlocking transition in coupled complex Ginzgburg-Landau equations is a generic phenomenon, which is independent on the details of the model and the type of forcing considered.
the system is frequency locked for small forcing, and it becomes frequency unlocked for large forcing, which can be understood by a perturbation analysis.
a spatial frequency forcing can be used to control the wave-unlocking transition in a system.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the frequency of the modulated standing wave is not affected by the amplitude of the forcing, which is in contrast to the case of the temporally periodic state that is generated when the forcing exceeds the unlocking threshold.
, even though the forcing is spatially periodic, the temporal behavior of the solutions is periodic.
spatial forcing can induce temporal dynamics in a system of standing waves.
